kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستقرئ (form X)
# نَسْتَقْرِئُ (nastaqriʔu) /nas.taq.ri.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# نَسْتَقْرِئَ (nastaqriʔa) /nas.taq.ri.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# نَسْتَقْرِئْ (nastaqriʔ) /nas.taq.riʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
